name: Alphard al-Shua
original_name: アルファルド・アル・シュヤ
source: A Middle-Eastern girl who has ties to the American CIA and the mastermind of the kidnapping plot. She first appears as "Canaan", masquerading as Oosawa Maria's friend to gain the trust of Oosawa Hitomi.
